# goslop text fixture (.txt) — materialized to .py at test/runtime
# Non-security MD5 fingerprints: bench checksum, ICC profile ID, PDF /ID,
# font subset tag, XMP UUID seed, and test digest equality.
lang: python
file: CWE-328-fingerprint-safe.py
---
import hashlib


def run_bench(data: bytes) -> dict:
    results = {}
    results["md5"] = hashlib.md5(data).hexdigest()
    return results


def stamp_icc_profile_id(profile: bytes) -> bytes:
    profile_id = hashlib.md5(profile).digest()
    return profile[:84] + profile_id + profile[100:]


def pdf_trailer_id(writer) -> bytes:
    digest = hashlib.md5()
    writer.feed_digest(digest)
    return digest.digest()


def subset_tag(face_name: str) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.md5(face_name.encode("ascii")).digest()
    return "".join(chr(65 + (byte % 16)) for byte in digest[:6])


def uuid_from_seed(*parts: str) -> bytes:
    return hashlib.md5("|".join(parts).encode("utf-8")).digest()


def assert_pdf_bytes_equal(first: bytes, second: bytes) -> None:
    assert first == second
    assert hashlib.md5(first).hexdigest() == hashlib.md5(second).hexdigest()
